error_message: target frontend: failed to solve: process "/bin/sh -c npm run build" did not complete successfully: exit code: 2
root_cause: Unresolved git merge conflicts in src/components/rewards/RewardShop.tsx and src/index.css caused typescript compilation error TS1185 and css syntax error.
fix: Removed merge conflict markers and successfully merged the conflicting imports and UI elements in RewardShop.tsx and index.css.

error_message: After login all pages and components are non-functional and non-interactive
root_cause: Imperative functions (completeTask, uncompleteTask, createTask, etc.) made API calls but never invalidated React Query caches. UI stayed stale after every action. Additionally, TaskList had hardcoded fallback demo data with undefined task references that made clicks no-ops, and HomePage quick-add section had readOnly inputs with no state.
fix: Added queryClient.invalidateQueries() calls to all imperative functions. Removed fake fallback demo data from TaskList. Replaced HomePage readOnly inputs with functional form backed by createTask(). Added inline task creation form to TaskList.

error_message: Uncaught TypeError: e.createdAt.getHours is not a function
root_cause: API returns date fields (createdAt, completedAt) as ISO strings, not Date objects. Calling .getHours() / .getTime() directly on strings throws TypeError.
fix: Wrapped all date field access in new Date() before calling Date methods in formatTaskTime (HomePage.tsx) and buildMoodCurve/peakHour (DailySummary.tsx).

error_message: Reward shop had no reachable redeem action and /rewards/redemptions was not implemented on the backend
root_cause: RewardShop kept redeemTarget state and frontend hooks requested /rewards/redemptions, but RewardCard never exposed an onRedeem control and the backend dynamic /:id route shadowed the missing redemptions endpoint.
fix: Added a redeem button with confirmation wiring, added GET /rewards/redemptions before /:id, invalidated reward/point caches after imperative reward mutations, and localized redemption ledger reasons.

error_message: Settings backup and restore buttons only showed coming-soon toasts despite an existing sync backend
root_cause: Frontend settings UI was never connected to the existing /sync and /sync/initial endpoints.
fix: Implemented JSON backup export through /sync and JSON restore through /sync/initial, with file validation and query invalidation after restore.

error_message: Login and action buttons rendered with missing accent/background variables and looked disabled or invisible
root_cause: Components referenced --color-accent, --color-bg-primary, and --color-bg-secondary, but index.css only defined theme palette tokens, not these alias variables.
fix: Defined root alias variables for accent, backgrounds, muted text, and danger colors; verified desktop and mobile screenshots show a readable green login button.

error_message: npm --prefix server test -- companion.test.ts failed with ECONNREFUSED ::1:3001
root_cause: New route integration test used the same external-server assumption as existing route tests, but no local server was running in the default test environment.
fix: Gated the new companion route test behind TEST_BASE_URL or RUN_SERVER_TESTS and changed its fallback base URL to the current backend port 5052.
